{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Reduce forecast overshoots following sharp price spikes (especially when sentiment is negative or neutral).",
    "Adjust downward for persistent negative sentiment, as models tend to overreact to pessimism.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias when price deviates >15% from 30-day moving average, especially after volatility spikes.",
    "Increase downward bias when sentiment history includes multiple consecutive negative values (e.g., -0.25 or below).",
    "Avoid over-optimism in early forecast periods (e.g., first 5 days of 30d forecast) when sentiment is weak or mixed.",
    "Correct for lagged reactions: if true outcome drops after forecast peak, reduce subsequent forecast by 5-10% to avoid overcorrection.",
    "When sentiment shifts from positive to negative mid-period, reduce forecast slope to prevent runaway declines.",
    "Use sentiment as a filter: if sentiment > 0.20, allow slight upward bias; if < -0.20, apply downward bias with 10-15% attenuation."
  ]
}
